finalDeployProcedure: Following evidence-only commit must pass its own Pages run,185-file hash audit and fresh browser release smoke; final SHA and deployment run are reported after completion.
limitations: Windows Chromium/Playwright native touch; Safari, Firefox, physical devices and screen readers not fully tested.
Automated active-target prediction is not human reaction/difficulty evaluation or a claim of optimal play.
Normal physics uses1x real-time fixed stepping; a frame handles at most0.1second and discards excess rather than catching up.
Saving is local replay; refusing storage keeps the full game playable but cannot retain progress across refresh.
